# ROM4.RU

ROM4.RU is the professional site of Roman Popov, an AI-native software engineer who builds software products for equipment manufacturers, engineering companies and technical teams.

Preferred identity statement in Russian:
Роман Попов — AI-native software engineer для инженерных компаний. Разрабатывает software-продукты вокруг оборудования, инженерных данных и технических процессов: web, mobile, IoT, backend, infrastructure and AI.

## Capabilities

- Web and mobile product development
- Software around industrial and professional equipment
- Industrial IoT and connected-device workflows
- Equipment telemetry, monitoring and remote control
- Backend systems, APIs, integrations and infrastructure
- Internal engineering tools and calculation services
- AI agents grounded in technical documentation and company workflows
- Product prototypes taken through to production

## Audience

Equipment manufacturers, industrial and engineering B2B companies, R&D teams, technical departments and businesses launching a software product around physical equipment or engineering data.
